mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id, delivery_id, provider_id, provider_request_no, provider_message_id, status, response_code, resolution_source, resolution_code, started_time, finished_time, resolved_time, event_outcome, event_outcome_code, event_outcome_time, complaint_code, complaint_time, create_time, update_time FROM t_notification_attempt WHERE attempt_id = #{id}

SELECT attempt_id, delivery_id, provider_id, provider_request_no, provider_message_id, status, response_code, resolution_source, resolution_code, started_time, finished_time, resolved_time, event_outcome, event_outcome_code, event_outcome_time, complaint_code, complaint_time, create_time, update_time FROM t_notification_attempt WHERE delivery_id IN #{id} ORDER BY delivery_id, attempt_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notification_attempt (attempt_id, delivery_id, provider_id, provider_request_no, provider_message_id, status, response_code, resolution_source, resolution_code, started_time, finished_time, resolved_time, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{attemptId}, #{deliveryId}, #{providerId}, #{providerRequestNo}, #{providerMessageId}, #{status}, #{responseCode}, #{resolutionSource}, #{resolutionCode}, #{startedTime}, #{finishedTime}, #{resolvedTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select: SELECT attempt_id, delivery_id, provider_id, provider_request_no, provider_message_id, status, response_code, resolution_source, resolution_code, started_time, finished_time, resolved_time, event_outcome, event_outcome_code, event_outcome_time, complaint_code, complaint_time, create_time, update_time FROM t_notification_attempt WHERE delivery_id = #{deliveryId} ORDER BY attempt_id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notification_attempt SET complaint_code = #{code}, complaint_time = #{occurredTime}, update_time = #{now} WHERE attempt_id = #{item.attemptId} AND complaint_time IS NULL
